thread:
Maya Patel: Announcing Nina Alvarez as Director, Model Onboarding — she starts 2025-07-01 and will lead model rollouts, onboarding checklists, and partner integrations. Welcome Nina! We'll also be making two immediate hires: Senior Model Onboarder (IC) and Onboarding Engineering Manager.

Nina Alvarez: Thrilled to join Redwood. My first priority is tightening our onboarding SLAs and reducing time-to-production for new models. I'll run office hours the first two weeks to hear pain points.

Leah Kim: Recruiting has approval to post both roles tomorrow. Note: we	have a new interview policy—starting now all external hires require a 3-interviewer slate (including one cross-functional) and a documented diversity slate. I'll attach the updated hiring rubric to the req.

Jordan Kim: Quick clarifying Q: does the 3-interviewer rule apply to internal transfers?

Maya Patel: Internal transfers keep a lighter loop (1 hiring manager + 1 peer) unless the role is customer-facing or infra-critical—then follow the external loop.

people-ops-bot: Maya Patel added event "Model Onboarding AMA with Nina" to calendar Wed 09:30-10:00  attendees: all@company

Diego Morales: Two operational notes: please freeze new contractor authorizations into Model Onboarding for four weeks while Nina triages priorities. Also, update the interview panel availability doc so recruiting can schedule faster.

Priya Natarajan: We'll keep SLAs the same, but expect a short ramp to stabilize ownership boundaries. Nina, we'll draft a rollout checklist for June 30 to ensure no regressions.

Samir Rao: For interviewers: please review the technical rubric for the Senior Model Onboarder—there's a new section on debugging KV cache and routing regressions. If you want to opt out of paneling, DM Leah ASAP so she can plan backups.

Leah Kim: Recruiting timeline: target 5-7 weeks from post. If a hiring manager needs a faster timeline, add a comment to the req and propose preferred interviewers.

Maya Patel: Thanks everyone. Welcome again, Nina. Please bring any process suggestions to the AMA or ping people-ops with questions.
